application.title: Rezone Petition Recommendation - 7306 Springfield Ave (Joy Property)

resolutions.summary: The Planning Commission voted unanimously that the requested zoning change from B-L to B-G is not the best path forward. As an alternative, the Commission recommended to the Mayor and Town Council that the B-L zone be modified to allow automobile service garages as a conditional use. The applicant's counsel had proposed that service garages with three or fewer bays be a permitted use and those with more than three bays be a conditional use.
